P1.prompt: The attached image shows the mascot character: an adult mint green sea otter. Draw this SAME character, same head, same face and same colours, in a NEW pose. Premium modern flat vector mascot illustration, the kind of polished, minimal character art used in a high-end education app. Crisp hard edges, perfectly smooth confident curves, NO outlines, NO gradients, NO shading, NO shadows, NO texture, NO glow, pure white background, nothing else in the image: no water, no bubbles, no plants, no text. Exactly four flat colours: fur #72BFA4 (soft mint green), belly and chest #DDF1E8 (pale mint), muzzle patch #F2FAF6 (near white), eyes and nose #191D18 (ink). Face: a big round head, two small round ears low on the sides of the head, a wide near-white muzzle patch shaped like two puffy cheeks with a small notch in the middle, two small ink-black dot eyes set wide apart above the muzzle, a wide soft ink-black nose, three tiny whisker dots on each cheek, no mouth line, no eyebrows, no blush. Pose: a sea otter gliding underwater, diving gracefully toward the LOWER LEFT. The whole body follows ONE smooth flowing S-curve from the nose to the tip of the tail, like a ribbon, full of gentle motion and joy. The head leads the dive at the lower left; the body is soft and plump but streamlined, NOT a stiff block and NOT a long thin tube; the back makes one clean arc. Both small front paws are tucked together just under the chin, held close to the chest. The two hind feet trail together behind, small, with softly webbed toes, and the thick tapered tail continues the curve of the spine and ends in a soft rounded tip at the upper right. The silhouette is simple and instantly readable, with clean negative space; limbs never stick out stiffly. Adult, calm and elegant proportions (the head about one quarter of the total length), cute but not babyish, clearly a sea otter and not a seal. The face looks toward the viewer so both eyes and the nose are clearly visible.
